{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 out of 344)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full series to capture all values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'Highest mean species: {highest_mean_species}')

# Print the highest mean value
print(f'Highest mean value: {mean_flipper_by_species.max()}')

# Also print the count per species to support any caveats
print('\nSpecies counts in cleaned data:')
print(df_clean['species'].value_counts().sort_index())"}
